blocks.text: Is phylum mein sponges aate hain. Zyada tar marine (samandari) hain, kuch meethe paani (freshwater) mein rehte hain. Leucosolenia aur Euplectella (Venus' flower basket) samandari sponges hain; Spongilla meethe paani ka aam sponge hai.
Bazaar ka (commercial) sponge is tarah banta hai: sponge ko sukha kar, koot kar aur dho kar us ke tamam cells nikal diye jate hain; sirf skeleton bachta hai.

Sponges mein tissue level organization nahi hoti, yani cells mil kar asal tissues nahi banate. Zyada tar sponges asymmetrical (be-tarteeb shakal) hain, kuch mein radial symmetry hoti hai. In mein nervous system nahi hota. Body wall mein bohat se chhote soorakh hote hain jinhein ostia kehte hain; inhi se paani jism mein daakhil hota hai. Bara soorakh jis se paani bahar nikalta hai osculum kehlata hai. Jism ki bahar wali layer patle, chapte cells ki hoti hai jinhein pinacocytes kehte hain. Doosri layer jelly jaisi hai aur mesohyle kehlati hai; is mein amoeboid cells hote hain. Teesri layer, jo andar ki khaali jagah (spongocoel) ko line karti hai, choanocytes ya collar cells ki hoti hai. Skeleton calcium carbonate ya silica ki bareek sooiyon (spicules) ki shakal mein hota hai. Zyada tar sponges budding ya regeneration se asexual reproduction karte hain. Kuch sponges mazboot capsules banate hain jinhein gemmules kehte hain. Jab parent sponge mar jata hai to gemmules aazad ho jate hain; achhe mahol (favourable environment) mein gemmules se amoeboid cells bahar aa kar naya sponge bana lete hain.

blocks.alt: Baayen: sponge ki aam banawat. Guldaan (vase) jaisa sponge kat kar dikhaya gaya; spongocoel ke gird choanocytes; paani ostia se andar aa kar osculum se bahar jata hai. Deewar ka bara tukra: pinacocytes, mesohyle (amoeboid cells aur spicule) aur choanocytes, beech se ek ostium. Ek choanocyte, collar aur flagellum ke saath. Daayen column: Leucosolenia (halki shaakhdaar nalkiyan), Euplectella (safed sheeshe jaisa guldaan) aur Spongilla (hara shaakhdaar sponge).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Hare teer paani ka raasta dikhate hain: paani deewar ke chhote soorakhon (ostia) se andar aata hai, beech ki khaali jagah (spongocoel) mein jata hai aur upar ke bare soorakh (osculum) se bahar nikalta hai. Is bahao ko choanocytes (collar cells) apne flagella hila kar chalate hain, aur collar paani se khurak ke zarre pakarta hai. Deewar ki teen tahein: bahar chapte pinacocytes, beech mein jelly jaisa mesohyle jis mein amoeboid cells aur sooi jaise spicules (skeleton) hain, aur andar choanocytes.

blocks.alt: Guldaan (vase) jaisa sponge, kaat kar dikhaya gaya take us ki deewar aur darmiyani cavity nazar aaye. Bahar ki satah par bohat se chhote soorakh (ostia); upar ka bara soorakh osculum; andar ki layer collar cells (choanocytes) ki hai jin par flagella hain; layers ke darmiyan jelly jaisa mesohyl hai jis mein amoeboid cells aur sooi jaise spicules hain. Teer dikhate hain ke paani ostia se andar aa kar osculum se bahar jata hai.
blocks.caption: Sponge ki aam banawat (Figure 1.9 ke mutabiq asal 3D model).
blocks.long_description: Paani body wall ke ostia se andar khincha jata hai, spongocoel ko dhaanpne wale choanocytes ke paas se guzarta hai, aur upar ke ek bare osculum se bahar nikalta hai. Bahar wali layer pinacocytes, darmiyan mein mesohyl (amoeboid cells aur spicules ke saath), aur andar wali layer choanocytes.
